name: Rubik's Cubers 3x3 (Stitch)
description: The Rubik’s Cubers 3x3 – Stitch Edition is a fun and collectible twist on the classic Rubik’s Cube, featuring the beloved Disney character Stitch from Lilo & Stitch. This special edition cube showcases a custom design with removable ears and Stitch’s playful expression on the front, making solving even more enjoyable for Rubik’s fans and Disney lovers alike.
